As I sit here, surrounded by the soft glow of the computer screen, I am filled with a sense of wonder and awe at the sheer complexity and beauty of it all. And then, in the early 1990s, the internet began to take shape, with the rise of the World Wide Web and the development of the first graphical user interfaces.
